name: Like Lovers Do
source:
On a morning stroll, you manage to bump into the new transferi! Oh how things change. You didn't even realize the love triangle blooming between you, your bestfriend and the new transferi! How will you navigate this school year with the blooming feelings between all of you three? Will you even manage to pick one? Will you even survive this school year? Well let's hope, you wouldn't wanna miss graduation!

[From [url=https://mtwopoint0.itch.io/likeloversdo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
早上散步时，你偶然遇到了新的换乘车！噢，事情发生了怎样的变化。你甚至没有意识到你、你最好的朋友和新转职者之间正在展开的三角恋！你们三个之间的感情正在蓬勃发展，你将如何度过这个学年？你能选出一个吗？你能活过这个学年吗？好吧，希望你不想错过毕业典礼！

[来自[url=https://mtwopoint0.itch.io/likeloversdo]itch.io[/url]]
